summary: Register EKODI Local Commerce as a path-scoped responsible independent service for multi-tenant promotional vouchers, coupons, points, merchant redemption and human-reviewed settlement records.
approvalBasis: The platform owner explicitly instructed EKODI, after reviewing the independent merchant-association, autonomous-district, institution and organization model, to collaborate through EKODI governance and complete the actual system through guarded deployment.
constitutionalInterpretation: This amendment adds one evidence-backed service boundary without changing Generation 10, workspace identity authority, provider independence, human sovereignty, or the prohibition on autonomous high-impact financial execution.
authorityImpact: None. Issuers operate only within their immutable workspace authority; EKODI AI receives no payment, settlement, or cross-tenant authority.
financialSafety: MVP supports promotional voucher/coupon/point value only. Stored-value cash custody, autonomous money transfer and unlicensed prepaid-money execution remain disabled.
migrationPolicy: Additive D1 local_commerce_* schema and path-scoped Worker rollout; existing services and workspace routes remain intact.
rollbackPlan: Revert the Local Commerce Worker, Control API route, service registries and boundary records through the guarded release lane. The additive local_commerce_* tables may remain dormant without affecting existing services or moving money.
generationImpact: None. Generation 10 Self-Architecture Optimization remains the current baseline and no Generation 11 promotion is implied.
